en.name: Battle of Austerlitz
en.description: The Battle of the Three Emperors, 2 December 1805, from 07:30: Kienmayer is going in at Telnitz, the allied columns are coming down off the Pratzen, and Soult's two divisions are still hidden behind the Goldbach. Davout is not here yet - III Corps marches on from Gross-Raigern at 08:30, the hour it arrived. 12.8 by 12.8 km at 50 m a tile, with the Satschan and Menitz ponds restored and the motorway and railway stripped out. 372 units from Nafziger's orders of battle: 197 battalions, 116 double squadrons and 59 batteries, each named.

value.title: Davout Comes Up From Gross-Raigern
value.message: The head of Friant's division is on the Telnitz lane after a night march from Gross-Raigern, marching for Sokolnitz.

value.title: Bourcier's Dragoons Close Up
value.message: The 4th Dragoon Division comes up behind Friant on the same road.
